messages:
emma.sales: Signed: PineWorks Labs (mid-market). SOW in — private dedicated pool + Okta SSO + audit logs. Go-live requested 2026-06-01. Trial ends 2026-05-05. They said renewal will be at-risk if onboarding lags.

rory.cs: I'll own onboarding. Primary CS=rory.cs. Need quick triage with eng/support. @dan.support please open intake and add GDPR tag (they handle EU clients).

dan.support: Ticket created PWK-ONB-3001 https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PWK-ONB-3001. Labels: onboarding, vpc, dataprivacy. Assigning eng-platform+eng-runtime+cs.

jia.eng: From eng: required QPS, avg tokens, model preference, latency SLO, datadog integration? Also service account + CIDR needed.

rory.cs: Customer answers: peak 8 RPS, avg 45 tokens, p95 <500ms. Prefer start on quantized 13B private, then eval 33B. Wants Datadog forwarding.

emma.sales: Sent sample prompts + admin list to rory.cs. Also added note: please prioritize audit log validation in first 7 days.

rory.cs: Action owners & dates:
- rory.cs: onboarding doc + admin training deck (due 2026-05-10)
- jia.eng: infra plan + CIDR confirmation (due 2026-04-30)
- dan.support: support access + compliance checklist attach (due 2026-04-28)
- emma.sales: share PO + billing contact (done)

infra-bot: PWK-ONB-3001 created by dan.support. SLA 72h to initial plan. Tags: GDPR, VPC, audit-logs.

jia.eng: Recommend staging private cluster with audit-logging and Datadog forwarder. Start with 13B quantized; collect eval prompts and run 24h smoke at 5rps.

rory.cs: Scheduling triage call: Mon 2026-04-27 08:00 PT. Please update PWK-ONB-3001 with owners, attach SOW + prompts when available. Flagging renewal-watch in CRM.

emma.sales: Thanks team. :rocket:
